about: Sunday edition, built after the 1:00 kickoffs: only the 4:05, 4:25, Sunday-night and Monday games can still be picked (the Thursday, London and 1:00 games had kicked off with no Week 7 board, so they have no Desk picks). Injury news is from the final reports (Friday; Saturday for Monday night) via NFL.com, team sites, Arrowhead Pride, Bleeding Green Nation and Inside The Star; 4:00 inactives were not out yet, so check them before using a pick. Anytime TD prices are from Fri Oct 23 and yardage lines from Thu Oct 22, the latest the free feeds have posted (no yardage lines for the 4:25, Sunday-night or Monday games). News is shown next to each pick but is not added to the Desk numbers (books move on it).
bar: Players ruled out are dimmed and dropped from the TD and Games tabs.

Puka Nacua.n: Questionable (calf), hurt in Thursday practice and sat Friday. Schefter: Rams 'optimistic' he plays; Rapoport: 'up in the air'. Check 4:25 inactives.

Patrick Surtain II.n: CB; questionable (ankle), missed the last two games; Rapoport said Denver likely without him.

Jonah Coleman.n: Questionable (ankle) on the final report; reported as expected to play.

Carson Beck.n: Backup QB; questionable (back). Jacoby Brissett is the ARI starter.

Mike Washington Jr..n: Questionable (foot/back); missed the last two practices.

Josh Jacobs.n: Activated to the active roster from the exempt list.

Travis Kelce.n: No game status (ankle) after three limited practices.

Drew Lock.n: Backup QB; questionable (right elbow). Sam Darnold starts.

Saquon Barkley.n: Questionable (hamstring) despite a full practice; could miss a third straight game. Monday final status pending.

Tanner McKee.n: Starts Monday with Jalen Hurts on injured reserve. The nflverse schedule lists Hurts, so the Desk overrides it with McKee.

George Pickens.n: Back from the shoulder injury; good to go.

den-ari: DEN: out are RB Tyler Badie, OLB Jonah Elliss and S Talanoa Hufanga; CB Patrick Surtain II (ankle) and RB Jonah Coleman (ankle) are questionable, and Surtain has missed two straight.
ARI: out are RB Jeremiyah Love, OL Jon Gaines II, DL Walter Nolen and S Andrew Wingard; questionable are QB Carson Beck, DL Darius Robinson, CB Max Melton and S Budda Baker. Jacoby Brissett starts.
gb-det: GB: LB Zaire Franklin is out; WR Bo Melton, G Aaron Banks, DT Jordon Riley and CB Benjamin St-Juste are questionable. RB Josh Jacobs was activated from the exempt list.
DET: no injury designations; S Brian Branch among those returning.
la-lv: LA: LB Nate Landman is out; WR Puka Nacua (calf, hurt Thursday) and CB Trent McDuffie (groin) are questionable. The Rams are 'optimistic' on Nacua (Schefter).
LV: WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. and TE Carter Runyon are out; RB Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is questionable after missing two practices.
kc-sea: KC: out are RB Brashard Smith, WR Rashee Rice and RT Jaylon Moore; LT Josh Simmons went to injured reserve. CB L'Jarius Sneed is questionable; Travis Kelce (ankle) has no status.

SEA: out are RB Zach Charbonnet and LBs Chazz Surratt and Drake Thomas; questionable are QB Drew Lock (backup), DeMarcus Lawrence, Uchenna Nwosu, Connor O'Toole and S Nick Emmanwori. Sam Darnold starts.
dal-phi: DAL: out are WR KaVontae Turpin, OT Drew Shelton and LB Dee Winters; LB Marist Liufau and S P.J. Locke are questionable (need IR activation). George Pickens, Joey Porter Jr., Tyler Guyton, DeMarvion Overshown and Cobie Durant return.

PHI: out are WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, OLB Nolan Smith and CB Michael Carter II; RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring), TEs Grant Calcaterra and Eli Stowers, G Landon Dickerson and OLBs Jonathan Greenard and Jalyx Hunt are questionable. Tanner McKee starts with Jalen Hurts on injured reserve.
